event.name: 2026 Pokémon VGC World Championship
event.structure: Swiss into a single-elimination top cut, open team lists
event.seeding: seeded so the quarter-final pairings match the real bracket

spreads.reason: The rk9 open team lists publish species, held item, ability, nature and all four moves verbatim, but no stat points. Champions allots 66 stat points with a per-stat cap of 32, so a zero-point team is not the team that made this top cut. Every spread here was recreated: first from the Day 2 broadcast where a damage or turn-order read pins a stat against an already-pinned opponent, and otherwise by adopting a real spread from a same-species, same-item, same-nature set in the corpus. Where the two disagree the footage wins. Working notes and the per-set derivations live outside this repo; each set carries its own basis in spreads.json.

overrides.why: Occa Berry exists to survive Charizard-Y Heat Wave (138-164% unresisted at 0 HP), which only pays off with real HP investment. Sucker Punch covers the Speed deficit.

CORPUS SUBSTITUTION. Modal verified Adamant Life Orb Basculegion (x5 of 48); the 20-23 Spe band holds 18 of 48 sets against 12 at max. The old max-Speed entry rested on a mirror arms-race argument that does not survive: Weed's Jolly Basculegion (143) beats the Adamant ones whether they sit at 130 or at 119, so it never implied they were max. No VOD turn-order read touches any Basculegion, and the 8A Flare Blitz read cannot discriminate (0 Def gives 40.6-48.2% in sun, 13 Def gives 35.9-42.6%; the observed 41% sits in both). VGCPastes Champions M-B repository (773 teams, 4199 sets, all 66 SP), filtered to the same species + item + nature.

Jolly is paid for Speed; 32 SP reaches 169, one point above Timid Charizard-Y's 167. The Atk/HP split is now constrained, not assumed: 8A, Sanchez's Mega Charizard Y Weather Ball in sun took this Garchomp 100% -> 59% (41%). Anchoring the attacker at its own high-confidence 32 SpA (211), 41% requires >= 15 SP of special bulk - the old 32 Atk / 32 Spe / 2 HP is infeasible. Cheapest fits: 0 HP/15 SpD, 8 HP/9 SpD, 12 HP/6 SpD. Sitrus Berry favours the HP lean, and 12 HP/6 SpD leaves the most Attack (16). The read only disappears if Sanchez's Charizard is at <= 6 SP SpA, which contradicts its own entry.
Same as any Timid Mega Charizard Y: the nature is bought for the 167 Speed tier.

CORPUS SUBSTITUTION, and the most consequential change in this audit. Modest Mega Charizard Y is overwhelmingly a BULKY sun-setter in the corpus, not a special attacker: 94 of 119 Modest sets run SpA <= 11, and the median is 9. The mega slot is being paid for Drought and bulk while the team does the damage - which is exactly why these players chose Modest over Timid (Timid Mega-Y, by contrast, is the offensive one: 6 of 13 run max SpA). The old 32 SpA / 20 Spe / 14 HP sat at the 92nd percentile of SpA. Adopted the modal verified set inside the dominant archetype. NOTE the distribution is bimodal: the single most common exact spread is still the offensive 2 HP / 32 SpA / 32 Spe (x8), so if this looks wrong on tape, that is the alternative. VGCPastes Champions M-B repository (773 teams, 4199 sets, all 66 SP), filtered to the same species + item + nature.

CORPUS SUBSTITUTION. Modal verified Bold Sitrus Farigiraf (x4 of 24). Both VOD constraints survive: the 8C g2 joint damage solve needs Def >= 6 (26 clears it), and the turn-6 Trick Room order caps Spe at SP_K-10 <= 22 (this set runs 0 Spe). The old 32 HP / 32 Def / 2 SpD dumped SpD, which no Bold corpus Farigiraf does. VGCPastes Champions M-B repository (773 teams, 4199 sets, all 66 SP), filtered to the same species + item + nature.
Rock Tomb instead of Protect makes it a speed-control attacker, which wants to move first.

Speed is now observed, not guessed. 8C game 2 turn 6 ran under Trick Room (proved independently: Yamazaki's Adamant Garchomp, >=122 Spe before its Choice Scarf and unparalysed, moved LAST), and Greppi's own Farigiraf moved BEFORE his Kingambit. Under TR the slower acts first, so Spe(Farigiraf) <= Spe(Kingambit): 80+SP_F <= 70+SP_K, i.e. SP_K >= SP_F+10 >= 10. A speed tie does not weaken this - it forces SP_K = SP_F+10 exactly, still >=10. With Farigiraf at the estimated 0-4 Spe this reads SP_K >= 10-14. Separately, Earthquake from that Garchomp (spread, 2x into Dark/Steel) took Kingambit 100%->31% = 69%, which excludes physically bulky allocations: 32 HP/12 Def caps at 61.8-63.8% and 16 HP/20 Def at 62.8-67%, both short of 69% even at max Garchomp Attack. So low Def, limited HP, real Speed - Trick Room is the side mode on this team, not the plan.

8A g1 t4 Heat Wave read (100%->77%, exactly 23%) re-solved for internal consistency. Against Onishi's Timid Mega Charizard Y at its own recorded 32 SpA (211) the feasible set is HP>=26 AND SpD>=26, so the previous 22 SpD was INFEASIBLE against the anchor this file already assumes. 32 HP / 8 Def / 26 SpD is the max-bulk fit. The Last Respects read adds nothing (engine always computes Last Respects at BP 50; fainted count and attack stage unknown), so it imposes no Def floor. CAVEAT: 26 SpD is a corpus outlier (1 of 43 Impish Sitrus Incineroar sit above 23 SpD). The read is monotone in the attacker: a Charizard at ~16 SpA instead would need only ~16 SpD, giving the corpus-normal 32 HP / 18 Def / 16 SpD. Both branches fit the footage; this one keeps the recorded Charizard entry.
